title: Review of c03's metabolic FCH micelles: replicated on seed 5 with the precursor-cut fork and the gate-off control (Supported; E partly by construction)
summary: Fresh seed 5, labkit run of world.py (150 frames x 400 steps, T=1200), plus world_cut400.py and world_beta0.py on the same seed and c03's fork.py and cargo_contrast.py. From white noise ~26 micelles form by t~200 and grow to 63-70 bodies, 41 splits / 34 persistent, max generation 3, 0 merges; the shell q is membrane-like in 286/288 individuals (rim/core 12.5, rim/outside 4.6), and catalyst is held at 58x-1132x with 97-100% of bodies >= 2x (a few freshly split bodies at ~0x). Precursor cut at t=400: 42/42 founder lineages dead by t~1000 (0 bodies), while in the fed twin 41/42 live and the count rises to 68. Gate off (beta=0): 26/26 dead by t~490. So the claim replicates in every gated test I ran.

observations.S: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=0: white noise over the whole domain; bodies appear by t=48
observations.I: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=208-1200: 26 -> 63-70 discrete micelles of constant size, 0 merges
observations.B: rerun/seed5/FACTS.md radial shell q: rim/core 12.5, rim/outside 4.55, 286/288 individuals membrane-like; sheet.png pink rings
observations.W: numbers.txt cargo_contrast: catalyst inside/outside 58-1132x, 97-100% of bodies >= 2x; beta0/ (gate off, seed 5): 26/26 bodies dead by t~490
observations.D: rerun/seed5/lineage.png: 34 persistent splits, max generation 3, merge/split 0; sheet.png t=312-1200 paired daughters with rings
observations.E: cut400/sheet.png and numbers.txt: precursor cut at t=400, 42/42 founder lineages dead by t~1000 vs 41/42 alive and multiplying to 68 bodies in the fed run

verdicts.limitation: E is partly by construction: amphiphile degrades at a fixed rate everywhere and is made only from the precursor, so any body must die without precursor; what is not by construction is that the shell must hold the catalyst (beta=0 kills every body). Catalyst leaks at fission (some daughters at ~0-0.1x for a frame; cargo_contrast weakest body 0.0x at frames 106 and 150). One fresh seed; I did not rerun chi_q=0, kc=0 or the 1.5x grid. Divisions stop as the precursor runs low (population levels off), so D is colonization-phase.
